justification: Both depict upright human-like figures shown in profile with an arm raised holding an implement, which is about as generic a correspondence as figural art offers. Everything else differs: A shows tiny, stick-like schematic figures in a loose scattered group with animal and abstract signs across an open surface, while B shows a single large, anatomically detailed winged genius with bird head, fringed garment, bucket and cone, framed by dense rosette-and-vine borders and an inscription band.
